notes.title: "GOOD WILL" UPDATE 1.06 is LIVE! Zombies + Sisters + Fixes Oh My!
notes.content:
Thank you one and all for supporting and playing [b]Rush Bros.[/b] Out of good faith, we are offering the zombies & Rush Sister skin packs for FREE. This is dedicated to our loyal fan base new and old. In addition, we have addressed a number of bugs that players have reported on forums. 

Please continue to support the game and recommend to your friends and family as the game truly shines when racing online or side-by-side!

[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
[list]
   [*]Skin Pack - Now select to play as the Rush Sisters Harmony or Melody, or even a Zombie!
   [*]The Zombeats -  A new 'Remix' option, you can turn Off the "Zombie Repellent" which will add a horde zombies to every level you play.
[/list]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
   [*]EULA Terms & Conditions
   [*]Achievement fixes - all levels
   [*]Control fixes
   [*]Other various fixes/edits
[/list]

[i]If your game does not automatically update be sure to verify your local game cache.[/i]

notes.title: New Update 1.03! New Levels! New Music!
notes.content:
- Added two new levels: ReverbNation & Dead Day Revolution
- Added four new songs from Dead Day Revolution and KK Slider.
- Added achievements for new levels.
- Fixed a bug with the pause menu where you could not pause with a keyboard in some situations.
- Bug fixes throughout levels.
- Leaderboards show your name with a yellow tint.  Your time is displayed along the right.
- Fixed random crash bug for Mac OSx 10.8.x users.  (Working on fix for previous versions)  If you encounter this crash please contact us at [url=www.playrushbros.com/support] www.playrushbros.com/support[/url]

Enjoy!!!

notes.title: Update 1.02b
notes.content:
Hello Rush brothers and sisters, we are happy to announce that update 1.02b is now live. There are two notable differences from the 1.02a beta quick fix: 

Fixes 1.02b
- Fixed some networking problems where players were not connecting before matches.
- Accept Challengers checkbox auto-checks; Also checks for available players before entering a level.
- Fixed several bugs throughout levels.
- Fixed leaderboard icons that did not match the associated level icon.
- Font and language fixes for existing languages, as well as new Finnish translation.
- Added command line argument "-nomovie" to skip the intro movie; Some players were experiencing problems with this.
- Added command line argument "-defaultplaylist" to clear any loaded playlists that may have caused problems for some players.
- Fixed playlist and mp3 bugs where some songs would not load properly.
- Added keybindings for in game music selection.
- Fixed a bug in the pause menu where selecting Exit Game did nothing.
- Fixed bugs with the dropping ceilings in levels 10, 20, 30 and 40.


If anyone is still having any issues please visit our support page at playrushbros.com/support
